create_employee.description: Add a new employee to BambooHR. Work emails have to be unique across the account.
create_employee.name: create_employee

parameters.description: The employee's first name.
parameters.name: first_name

parameters.description: The employee's last name.
parameters.name: last_name

parameters.description: The employee's work email. BambooHR rejects one that another employee already has.
parameters.name: work_email

parameters.description: The employee's job title.
parameters.name: job_title

parameters.description: The department the employee belongs to.
parameters.name: department

parameters.description: The division the employee belongs to.
parameters.name: division

parameters.description: The location the employee works from.
parameters.name: location

parameters.description: The day the employee started.
parameters.name: hire_date

parameters.description: The employee's mobile number.
parameters.name: mobile_phone

parameters.description: Any other BambooHR field, by its field name, including this account's custom ones. Run 'List fields' to see every name.
parameters.name: extra_fields

create_time_off_request.description: Request time off for an employee. They have to be on a policy for the type you choose.
create_time_off_request.display_str_template: Request BambooHR time off for employee {0} from {1} to {2}
create_time_off_request.name: create_time_off_request

parameters.description: The internal BambooHR employee ID, as returned by 'List employees'. This is not the editable Employee # shown on a profile.
parameters.name: employee_id

parameters.description: The first day of the absence.
parameters.name: start

parameters.description: The last day of the absence.
parameters.name: end

parameters.description: Which kind of time off this is.
parameters.name: time_off_type_id

parameters.description: How much time off, in the unit the chosen type is measured in, usually hours. Must be more than zero. Leave empty to let BambooHR work it out from the dates.
parameters.name: amount

parameters.description: What state to create the request in. Approving it outright needs the connected user to have that permission.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: A note to attach to the request.
parameters.name: note

delete_employee.description: Permanently delete a BambooHR employee and everything attached to them. This cannot be undone.
delete_employee.name: delete_employee

parameters.description: The internal BambooHR employee ID, as returned by 'List employees'. This is not the editable Employee # shown on a profile.
parameters.name: employee_id

get_company_information.description: Fetch your company's BambooHR profile: legal name, display name, address and phone number.
get_company_information.name: get_company_information

get_employee.description: Fetch one BambooHR employee's record by their internal employee ID.
get_employee.name: get_employee

parameters.description: The internal BambooHR employee ID, as returned by 'List employees'. This is not the editable Employee # shown on a profile.
parameters.name: employee_id

parameters.description: Which fields to return. Leave empty for the standard identity and job fields. Run 'List fields' to see every name this account has.
parameters.name: fields

parameters.description: Turn off to include future-dated rows from the history tables (job, compensation, status).
parameters.name: only_current

get_employee_directory.description: Fetch your company's published BambooHR employee directory: who everyone is, their job title, department and work contact details.
get_employee_directory.name: get_employee_directory

parameters.description: Turn off to also include people whose hire date is still in the future.
parameters.name: only_current

get_employee_table_data.description: Read one of an employee's history tables: job info, compensation, employment status, emergency contacts and the rest.
get_employee_table_data.name: get_employee_table_data

parameters.description: The internal BambooHR employee ID, or 'all' to read the table for every employee this connection can see.
parameters.name: employee_id

parameters.description: Which of the employee's tables to read.
parameters.name: table

get_report.description: Run one of your saved BambooHR reports and return its rows.
get_report.name: get_report

parameters.description: Which saved report to run.
parameters.name: report_id

parameters.description: Whether to collapse rows that are identical. BambooHR removes them by default.
parameters.name: deduplicate

parameters.description: Turn off to include future-dated values from the history tables.
parameters.name: only_current

get_time_off_balance.description: Work out how much time off an employee has left, as of today or a date you choose.
get_time_off_balance.display_str_template: Get BambooHR time off balances for employee {0}
get_time_off_balance.name: get_time_off_balance

parameters.description: The internal BambooHR employee ID, as returned by 'List employees'. This is not the editable Employee # shown on a profile.
parameters.name: employee_id

parameters.description: The date to calculate the balance for. A future date projects the balance forward. Defaults to today.
parameters.name: as_of

parameters.description: How precisely to round the balances.
parameters.name: precision

list_changed_employees.description: List the employees whose records were added, updated or deleted since a given moment: the way to keep another system in step with BambooHR.
list_changed_employees.name: list_changed_employees

parameters.description: Only report employees changed after this moment. Use the 'latest' value from the last run to pick up where it left off.
parameters.name: since

parameters.description: Which kind of change to report.
parameters.name: change_type

list_employees.description: List the employees in your BambooHR account, optionally filtered to one field's value and sorted, a page at a time.
list_employees.name: list_employees

parameters.description: Extra employee fields to include beyond the standard identity and job ones, by BambooHR field name, for example workEmail or hireDate. Run 'List fields' to see every name this account has.
parameters.name: fields

parameters.description: Narrow the list to employees whose chosen field matches 'Filter value'.
parameters.name: filter_field

parameters.description: The value the chosen field has to match.
parameters.name: filter_value

parameters.description: Look up specific employees by their internal IDs instead of listing everyone.
parameters.name: employee_ids

parameters.description: The order the employees come back in.
parameters.name: sort

parameters.description: How many employees to return in one page.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: The 'next_cursor' from a previous run of this step, to fetch the following page.
parameters.name: cursor

list_fields.description: List every employee field this BambooHR account has, custom fields included: the names the other steps accept.
list_fields.name: list_fields

list_reports.description: List the saved custom reports in your BambooHR account, so a later step can run one.
list_reports.name: list_reports

parameters.description: Which page of reports to return.
parameters.name: page

parameters.description: How many reports to return in one page.
parameters.name: page_size

list_time_off_policies.description: List the account's time off policies and which type of time off each one accrues.
list_time_off_policies.name: list_time_off_policies

list_time_off_requests.description: List the time off requests that overlap a date range, optionally narrowed to one employee, type or status.
list_time_off_requests.display_str_template: List BambooHR time off requests from {0} to {1}
list_time_off_requests.name: list_time_off_requests

parameters.description: The start of the window. A request is included when it is still running on this date, even if it began earlier.
parameters.name: start

parameters.description: The end of the window. A request is included when it has begun by this date, even if it runs on past it.
parameters.name: end

parameters.description: Only this employee's requests.
parameters.name: employee_id

parameters.description: Only this one request.
parameters.name: request_id

parameters.description: Only requests of these kinds of time off.
parameters.name: type_ids

parameters.description: Only requests in these states.
parameters.name: statuses

parameters.description: Whose requests to report, from the connected user's point of view.
parameters.name: scope

parameters.description: Turn on to omit the employee and manager notes from each request.
parameters.name: exclude_notes

list_time_off_types.description: List the kinds of time off this account tracks and the unit each is measured in.
list_time_off_types.name: list_time_off_types

parameters.description: Limit the list to the types the connected user is allowed to request time off under.
parameters.name: requestable_only

list_users.description: List the people with a BambooHR login, and which employee record each one belongs to.
list_users.name: list_users

parameters.description: Only report users whose login is in one of these states. Leave empty for all of them.
parameters.name: status

list_whos_out.description: See who is away between two dates, company holidays included. The range can span at most 366 days.
list_whos_out.display_str_template: List who's out in BambooHR from {0} to {1}
list_whos_out.name: list_whos_out

parameters.description: The first day of the window.
parameters.name: start

parameters.description: The last day of the window, at most 366 days after the first.
parameters.name: end

parameters.description: Only this employee's time away.
parameters.name: employee_id

parameters.description: Limit the answer to the connected user's direct reports.
parameters.name: direct_reports_only

parameters.description: Also return each absent employee's name and photo alongside the entries.
parameters.name: include_people

parameters.description: Which page of results to return.
parameters.name: page

parameters.description: How many entries to return in one page.
parameters.name: page_size
